name: Location pin chip
oneLiner: a glass location chip under the chin: a tiny street-map disc under a glass dome pops, the glass opens out with the place name, and a glossy map pin falls onto the map, squashes and sends a ripple, then pulses through the hold
say: when the video opens somewhere or the speaker says where they are ('I'm in Lisbon at the conference'): cut it in on the place name, set duration to the length of the shot to keep it up; sub for a venue or a day
